input.rationale: The only inbound grant to us is Section 1.4 (p0008-p0009): access to and the right to use HDI's hosting system, software and Content administration tools. It is granted to "the Company" alone, and "Company" is defined as The Deerskin Companies, Inc. (p0002) with no affiliate coverage anywhere in the Agreement, so the fallback element requiring affiliate coverage on written notice fails. The successor element is already satisfied by Section 10.3 (p0063), under which the Agreement inures to the benefit of and is enforceable by the parties' successors and assigns. The grant is not expressly revocable at HDI's discretion, so this is not walk-away territory; we therefore make the shortest fallback-level fix by extending the Section 1.4 access and use rights to our affiliates on written notice. Preferred extras (contractors, perpetual/irrevocable paid-up licence) are noted but not pursued at this level.

ops.text: The access and use rights granted to the Company under this Section 1.4 shall extend to the Company's affiliates upon written notice to HDI.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our playbook requires that licences granted to us cover our affiliates, so we have added that the Section 1.4 access and use rights extend to our affiliates upon written notice to HDI. Successor transfer is already preserved by Section 10.3.
proposal.summary: Extend the Section 1.4 access and use rights to the Company's affiliates on written notice.

mappings.element: Customer's affiliates are covered on written notice.
